dex.entry: A tiny darting water-sprite that skims the sea surface, trailing a thread of moonlit water behind it. So fast it appears to teleport between waves. The impossible-to-catch tiny speedster — Glintfin's spiritual counterpart that players spend hours trying to lamp.

art.silhouette: Tiny sprite, blue-white water droplet shape with trailing wisps, two pinpoint bright eyes, a single glowing ribbon-tail. Appears as a moving sparkle on water surfaces.
